name: Cauliflower Rice Peas Pulao
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: 300 g cauliflower, grated into rice-size pieces
¼ cup cooked quinoa or brown rice
1 bay leaf, 2 cloves and ½ tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp ginger and 1 green chilli, minced
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the whole spices. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Add ginger and chilli, then the peas and turmeric. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add the grated cauliflower and quinoa and stir-fry on high heat for 4 minutes; do not add water.
Season with garam masala and salt.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: A lower-carbohydrate pulao; the cauliflower is cooked briefly to keep it from turning soggy.
